question: Should OpenClaw land this curated OpenRouter image-model update as the base, fold it into the shared `/images` endpoint refactor, or defer curated model expansion behind the broader OpenRouter catalog policy?
rationale: The patch is useful, but the branch conflicts with current main and overlaps with two open OpenRouter image-model/provider PRs; automation cannot safely choose the permanent provider shape or catalog policy.

options.title: Rebase and integrate this work
options.body: Keep the six-model curated catalog and model-specific caps, then rebase and reconcile them with current main and the preferred `/images` endpoint implementation.

options.title: Use the shared endpoint PR as the base
options.body: If maintainers prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101367, close this only after the six current model IDs and caps are carried into that path or a narrow follow-up.

options.title: Defer curated expansion
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91504 open and defer model additions until maintainers settle dynamic versus curated OpenRouter image catalog policy.

recommendation.title: Rebase and integrate this work
recommendation.body: Keep the six-model curated catalog and model-specific caps, then rebase and reconcile them with current main and the preferred `/images` endpoint implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership and line blame make this the best available routing candidate for the rebase/provider-direction choice.
